info.title: Flock Energy — Urja Meter Ops API
info.description: Clean REST API proxy layer over the legacy Urja Meter Ops portal. Handles authentication, session management and response normalisation so downstream clients never talk to the legacy portal directly.

get.description:
Readiness: can we hold a session with the portal?

Unlike /health this talks to the portal, though at most once every few seconds
however often it is probed.

401.description: The portal rejected the service account's credentials

502.description: The portal answered with something we could not use

503.description: Portal unreachable; retry after the Retry-After delay

500.description: An unexpected error in this API (details are in its log, not here)

get.description:
The meter's half-hourly readings.

The portal serves one fixed window and takes no date range, so `from` / `to` cut that window here.
`value` is the cumulative kWh register; `interval_kwh` is the consumption in each interval.

interval_minutes.title: Interval Minutes
interval_minutes.description: Spacing of the readings (30 for this portal), when they are evenly spaced

portal_timezone.title: Portal Timezone
portal_timezone.description: The zone the portal's local timestamps were read in before being converted to UTC. The portal states none, so this is an assumption.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reading time, RFC 3339 UTC (2026-06-23T18:00:00Z). Readings whose time cannot be read are left out

value.title: Value
value.description: The meter's cumulative kWh register at that time, not the consumption in the interval (see interval_kwh). null if unparseable

interval_kwh.title: Interval Kwh
interval_kwh.description: kWh consumed since the reading one step earlier. Null for the first reading, after a missing or unreadable reading (the difference would span several intervals) and where the register fell

ConsumptionRecord.title: ConsumptionRecord
ConsumptionRecord.description: One data point in a consumption history.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. upstream_unavailable

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Also sent as the X-Request-ID response header

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description:
Consistent error body shape for every non-2xx response this API returns.

RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) that keep the `detail` message
v1 clients already read. `code` is stable: branch on it, not on `detail`.

FleetSummary.description: GET /api/v1/fleet/summary: counts for a dashboard, from the meter and transformer lists.

type.title: Type
type.description: multiple_parents, name_mismatch, incomplete_path, dt_mismatch, feeder_mismatch, dt_without_meters, meter_unknown_dt, meter_without_dt, unreadable_breadcrumb, missing_code or unknown_level

id.title: Id
id.description: The node or transformer the issue is about

HierarchyIssue.title: HierarchyIssue
HierarchyIssue.description: One thing in the hierarchy data that does not add up.

level.title: Level
level.description: zone, circle, division, subdivision, substation, feeder or dt

HierarchyLevel.title: HierarchyLevel
HierarchyLevel.description: One step of a meter's breadcrumb through the network.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The node's code, e.g. Z-01 or DT-007

node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: zone, circle, division, subdivision, substation, feeder or dt

meter_count.title: Meter Count
meter_count.description: Meters at or below this node

HierarchyNode.title: HierarchyNode
HierarchyNode.description: A node in the network hierarchy tree — GET /api/v1/hierarchy (optional extension).

checked.title: Checked
checked.description: What was examined: meters, transformers and breadcrumbs read

location.title: Location
location.description: The transformer the meter hangs off, which is the portal's closest thing to a place name. Coordinates are in latitude / longitude.

installed_date.title: Installed Date
installed_date.description: The portal shows no installation date, so this is always null

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Null when the portal has no usable coordinates

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
hierarchy.description: Breadcrumb from zone down to the transformer, as the portal shows it

raw_fields.title: Raw Fields
raw_fields.description: Any other parameter the portal lists for the meter that does not map to a named field above, kept rather than dropped. Only five meters' details were captured (see PROTOCOL.md), so other meters may carry more.

MeterDetail.title: MeterDetail
MeterDetail.description: A single meter's full detail — GET /api/v1/meters/{id}.

status.title: Status
status.description: Installation status as the portal reports it, upper-cased: INSTALLED, FAULTY or DECOMMISSIONED

location.title: Location
location.description: Null in the list; the meter's detail carries the transformer it hangs off

make.title: Make
make.description: Manufacturer, e.g. HPL, L&T, Genus, Allied, Secure

dt_code.title: Dt Code
dt_code.description: Distribution transformer the meter hangs off, e.g. DT-007

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Only filled when asked for (include=coordinates) or when a geo filter is used

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: Metres from lat/lon; only with the geo filter

hierarchy_path.title: Hierarchy Path
hierarchy_path.description: Codes from zone down to DT, e.g. ['Z-01', 'C-01', ...]; only with include=hierarchy

MeterSummary.title: MeterSummary
MeterSummary.description: One row of the meter listing — GET /api/v1/meters.

meter_count.title: Meter Count
meter_count.description: Meters that point at this transformer
